integrity: The primary open full text was inspected at the survival, hazard, hazard derivative, hazard-shape statement, and Figure 2 parameter configurations. The theorem is proved analytically through a monotone derivative-ratio transform. A standalone numerical checker was replayed from the packaged path only as a reproducibility aid.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers positive scales with both shape parameters strictly between zero and one; other shape regimes are not classified.
The unique minimum can occur far beyond practical observation windows.
A very recent or unindexed correction could exist outside the sources examined.
title: Both subunit FEPW shapes force a unique bathtub hazard
